top_signals.title: Health insurer points finger at AI as nearly $1 billion in questionable hospital charges appear
top_signals.summary: As AI codes billing inside hospitals, insurers say costs are added to a bloated health care system. Blue Cross Blue Shield put the tab as high as $1 billion.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Dutch say ASW frigate talks ongoing amid reports Belgium may quit project
top_signals.summary: Belgium is pushing to get new naval frigates on time, as a joint procurement with the Netherlands is delayed by years.
